title: Qualitative Analysis and Mixed Methods
answer: Thematic coding, interview transcription, pattern finding, ethnographic synthesis and combining the two kinds of data.

children.name: Thematic Coding
children.blurb: Thematic coding is a systematic method for identifying, organizing, and interpreting recurring patterns of meaning in qualitative data such as interview transcripts, focus group recordings, open-ended survey responses, and field notes.

children.name: Interview Transcription and Speaker Separation
children.blurb: Interview transcription and speaker separation covers converting recorded spoken interviews into text and attributing each utterance to the correct participant.

children.name: Finding Patterns in Lived Experience
children.blurb: Finding patterns in lived experience covers the use of computational and AI-assisted methods to analyze qualitative data such as interviews, focus groups, diaries, open-ended survey responses, and field notes.

children.name: Ethnographic Synthesis
children.blurb: Ethnographic synthesis is the systematic comparison and integration of findings from multiple ethnographic studies to build higher-order interpretations of cultural, social, or organizational phenomena.

children.name: Combining Qualitative and Quantitative Data
children.blurb: Combining qualitative and quantitative data covers research designs that bring narrative, textual, or observational material together with numeric measures, counts, or model outputs.

sections.body: Qualitative analysis and mixed methods cover the ways researchers work with words, observations, and open ended answers rather than numbers alone. In practice, artificial intelligence now transcribes recorded interviews, separates speakers in multi person recordings, suggests codes for passages of text, clusters similar responses, and drafts summaries of field notes. It also helps connect quotes and themes to survey scores or demographic data when a study mixes qualitative and quantitative material. These tools are used in sociology, public health, education, and user research, where the raw material is often messy and context dependent. The work here is assistive, not a replacement for a researcher reading closely.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The most reliable parts are transcription and initial coding on clear, well recorded speech and straightforward text. Speaker separation works well when voices are distinct and there is little overlap, but it still fails on crosstalk, heavy accents, or domain specific vocabulary. Thematic coding tools can propose labels and group similar passages, yet they miss sarcasm, metaphor, and cultural context, and they can overfit to frequent words. Ethnographic synthesis remains the least solved area because it requires interpreting meaning across long periods and multiple sources, which current models do only at a surface level. Combining qualitative and quantitative data is also limited, as AI can align themes with variables but cannot judge whether a mixed methods design is coherent or whether a contradiction is meaningful. Honest limits include hallucinated quotes, biased training data, and the need for a human to verify every coded passage and summary.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: A reader would begin with Interview Transcription and Speaker Separation to turn audio into usable text and to see how the tool handles multiple voices. From there, Thematic Coding shows how to apply and refine labels to that text, which is the core mechanical step in much qualitative work. Finding Patterns in Lived Experience moves beyond individual codes to broader themes and recurring ideas across participants, while Ethnographic Synthesis addresses the harder task of pulling together field notes, observations, and interviews into a single interpretive account. Finally, Combining Qualitative and Quantitative Data covers the mixed methods step, where themes and quotes are linked to numeric results, and where the limits of automated integration become clearest. Together the pages follow the workflow from raw recording to integrated analysis.
